newsitem.title: CANADA: Teck explains Adrian share terms.
newsitem.headline: Teck explains Adrian share terms.

text.p: Teck Corp said Wednesday that its agreement with Adrian Resources Ltd calls for it to buy two million Adrian shares on the open market or one million shares from Adrian's treasury.
Teck chief executive Norman Keevil said Adrian could choose which it wanted. The shares would be bought from the treasury for C$3.45 each. Adrian's shares are currently trading around C$2.25.
If Teck buys some shares on the open market, then the number of Adrian shares it might be asked to buy from the treasury would be reduced by the same proportion, Keevil said.
